verdict.rationale: An app lock behind biometrics or a PIN is a fair question for a password manager and TOTP app, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions biometric unlock, a PIN lock, or any app-level lock. The items cover TOTP generation, the CLI, import/export, Pass Monitor, and Sentinel account protection, none of which is an in-app lock.

support.subject: As an everyday user, the app itself locks behind biometrics or a PIN, so a borrowed phone doesn't expose my codes
